**Job Description

**Are you a self-starting transformation driver, strategic thinker and pragmatic deliverer, who turns a long-term vision and complex objectives into step-by-step reality and a clear path forward? Do you possess strong project management skills with the ability to translate a multi-year roadmap into smaller bricks and actionable wins, keeping momentum high as requirements evolve? Are you a gifted communicator who breaks down silos and unites cross-functional teams around a lean way of working? Do you possess the business acumen and analytical skills to spot risks and interdependencies across projects and complex organizations? **If so, join us as S&OP Project Manager!

****What The Job Is …

**We have embarked on a multi-year, enterprise-wide transformation program through 2030 to support the long-term growth and industrialization of Satair and Airbus Material Services. We are redesigning the Processes, Methods, Tools and Data (PMTD) across various domains and organizations, for a lean operating model powered by a Fit-to-Standard modern ERP and harmonized processes.

One of the key cornerstones of this transformation is the deployment of an integrated end-to-end Sales and Operations Planning process across various businesses.

In your position as S&OP Project Manager you will be part of a cross-functional and cross-organizational project team. In addition to designing and implementing the TO BE S&OP Processes, Methods, Tools and Data (PMTD), you will act as the key point between our external consultancy partners, internal business stakeholders and the broader enterprise transformation program.

_Travel required: 15%

_**How You Will Contribute To The Team

**

• PMTD and Architecture Design and Implementation: Design the target Process, Method, Tools and Data covering customer demand, supply capacity and feedback loop mechanisms, including scenario-planning and escalation protocols across and between businesses. Partner with IT and Digital to define the future ERP requirements for S&OP, ensuring a seamless and integrated architecture between Processes and Tools.

• Project Management: Define project roadmap, translate long-term ambition into short-term milestones, maintain project governance, ensure progress towards deliverables, identify and proactively manage interdependencies and risks.

• Stakeholder Alignment Beyond Silos: Proactively identify and engage senior stakeholders across functions and organizations in a complex environment to drive alignment on future ways of working, overcome organizational friction and secure global process simplification and standardization.

• Consultant Management: Lead the relationship with external consultants, steering their deliverables to shape our target S&OP Processes, Methods, Tools and Data (PMTD). Validate consultant proposals and recommendations against business needs and context, ensuring designs are scalable and implementable across various business units.

• Strategic Escalations & Executive Briefings: Prepare executive-ready decks, high-impact decision dossiers, trade-off analysis, recommendations and progress updates for executive forums and the central Transformation steering.

• ERP Fit-to-Standard (F2S): Drive business readiness and stakeholder participation across multi-functional teams for F2S workshops to design the future ERP requirements. Safeguard S&OP scope requirements within the central ERP system, ensuring seamless alignment between S&OP process and the future ERP capabilities.

• Ad-Hoc Initiatives: Lead other potential initiatives or projects related to S&OP.

**Candidate Profile & Qualifications

Core experience and background:

**

• Education: MSc/MA in Business, Economics, Strategy, Finance, Supply Chain or a related field

• Experience and Track record: 5-8+ years of experience in Project Management, Supply Chain, Management Consulting or equivalent. Proven track record in project management, S&OP deployment, leading cross-functional teams or enterprise process redesigns.

• Methodologies: Mastery of structured project management and business process mapping.

• Languages: Fluent English is mandatory. Good command of French or German is a plus.

**Work Style And Soft Skills

**

• You are self-driven, proactive and autonomous

• You can translate complex long-term objectives into clear sequential steps. You have a strong focus on driving progress and delivering results, ensuring execution momentum even when requirements change.

• You can balance strategic thinking with tactical execution

• You are analytical, and enjoy understanding the intricacies of how things work

• You are excellent at stakeholder management and can navigate large organizations with ease

• You are a natural communicator and consensus builder, with the ability to understand and demystify complex concepts to obtain stakeholder buy-in

• You have the ability to influence senior leaders, negotiating trade-offs and overcoming organizational resistance.

• You have excellent analytical skills and business acumen, able to translate complex information into clear recommendations

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At Satair, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow.

_Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

_**About SATAIR

**Satair offers first class material management solutions in the aftermarket business of the aviation industry. We are working to be the most customer-centric organization in providing commercial aviation spares parts to make the world continue flying. We are constantly taking customer experience to new levels by improving how we fulfill and deliver customers’ orders quickly and accurately, anywhere in the world. To meet this goal, Satair is continually striving to innovate and provide best-in-class service levels by pioneering new products and services in a fast growing business environment.

With our global functional organization spanning across 11 different sites and locations worldwide with more than 1.800 people and a turnover of $3.3 billion, you will be part of a truly global family.

Our customers have the ultimate goal to operate their fleet and our Airbus aircraft safely, efficiently in a cost-time-quality effective manner and of course with the expected comfort level for their customers. We at Satair do everything to support our customers in this.

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

_Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

_

• Competitive remuneration, including short term incentive bonus on all levels

• Work/life balance: hybrid working, flex time, maternity/paternity/parental leave, 29 days of holiday + senior and flex days

• Personal development: personalized development plans, large portfolio of learning solutions and many internal mobility opportunities, both locally and globally

• Health and well-being: Health insurance, in-house canteen with many healthy options

**Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

**Please send us your CV and application as soon as possible to become part of an exceptional global team! We will be having interviews on an ongoing basis.

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

When applying for the position, you accept our data privacy statement: http://www.SATAIR.com/privacy

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

****Who We Are

****Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

****People Experience Partner Nordics

******Salary Range: 643500 - 715000 annually

******Who We Are

****Colgate-Palmolive Company is a caring, innovative growth company that is reimagining a healthier future for all people, their pets, and our planet. Focused on Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, and Pet Nutrition, we sell our products in more than 200 countries and territories under globally recognized brands. We are celebrated for our leadership in sustainability, community wellbeing, and our unwavering commitment to living our core values.

Global People professionals are consistently drawn to Colgate-Palmolive by the exceptional opportunities for career advancement and a strong alignment with our purpose-driven company Values: We are Caring, We are Inclusive, We are Courageous. Within our Global People function, we foster a culture of high trust and autonomy, ensuring you feel empowered to make impactful decisions and directly influence our broader strategic priorities while you build a fulfilling, long-term career.

As a member of the People Experience team, you will be the heartbeat of the employee journey, owning the local execution of Global People programs and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can perform at their best and reach their full potential. You will be the primary partner for employees and managers in the Nordic Countries translating HR policies into practical solutions and driving operational excellence across the region. This is a unique opportunity for you to gain broad exposure across diverse businesses while influencing the growth and development of our global workforce.

In this role, you will act as a key generalist partner to employees and managers—guiding talent development, supporting organizational initiatives, supporting Employee Relations cases, and managing the employee lifecycle from onboarding through career transitions. Simultaneously, you will take ownership of accurate, compliant, and timely monthly payroll operations across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland, managing relationships with external providers and maintaining rigorous compliance with local labor and tax laws.

****Key Responsibilities

• People Experience Generalist

• Managing the execution of critical global People (HR) programs, including performance management, talent planning, learning & development and compensation, in close partnership with People Business Partners and Center of Excellence teams.

• Ensuring high quality experience around the "moments that matter" within the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, and key career transitions.

• Coaching and advising managers on employee relations, performance management, career development, and leadership capabilities to elevate team performance and engagement.

• Support in employee relations cases with sound judgment, ensuring alignment with local labor laws and GDPR.

• Driving continuous improvement by identifying and diagnosing operational bottlenecks, developing and managing the implementation of solutions, and leveraging AI and digital tools to optimize HR service delivery.

• Utilizing data analytics and organizational diagnostics to identify trends and translate insights into actionable solutions for the business..

• Providing on-the-ground-feedback and insights to People Business Partners, CoE, and CBS- ensuring the broader People function remains connected to what is happening across the organization.

• Payroll, Benefits & Administration

• End-to-End Nordic Payroll Preparation: Accurate and timely preparation, entry, and validation of monthly payroll inputs (e.g., variable pay, new hires, terminations, leaves, and tax changes) across all responsible countries

• Serving as the first point of contact for employee and manager inquiries regarding payslips, leave balances and benefits.

• Rigorous Output Validation: Thorough auditing and reconciliation of pre-payroll and final payrolls from the external payroll provider to ensure zero-defect processing.

• Provider Management: Strong day-to-day alignment with the external payroll provider, driving accountability and smooth communication flows. Validate payroll data to guarantee 100% accuracy and SOX compliance.

• Nordic Benefits Administration: Hands-on management of local benefits programs, such as health insurance, pensions etc. across the Nordics.

• Statutory Leave & Benefit Tracking: Expert handling and tracking of statutory leaves (parental, sick leave etc.), including claims for government reimbursements (e.g., Försäkringskassan, Udbetaling Danmark, NAV, Kela).

****Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree

• 4+ years of relevant, progressive human resources experience, combining HR Generalist responsibilities with hands-on payroll and benefits administration.

• Nordic Market Experience: Proven track record running and / or overseeing payroll and benefits administration across multiple Nordic countries

• Strong knowledge of Nordic labor laws, local tax structures, social security environments, and Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBAs).

• Hands-on experience working with cloud-based HRIS-platforms and major Nordic payroll solutions.

• Demonstrated ownership in managing competing priorities, multiple stakeholders, and complex timelines in a fast-paced environment.

• Professional fluency in at least one Scandinavian language (Danish, Swedish, or Norwegian) and excellent verbal and written communication in English

**Our Commitment to Inclusion

**Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

Curious about a role where you can make a real difference to production planning? As our End-to-End Planner, you will connect Operations, Procurement and Commercial—turning complex supply challenges into clear plans and informed decisions.

**The role

**You will own operational and tactical planning for relevant production lines, help balancing production, purchasing, inventory and customer needs. You will also contribute to a stronger, globally consistent planning processes.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Managing the full planning horizon in SAP ePPDS, from operational to tactical levels, including placing purchase orders with suppliers

• Maintaining and acting on SAP exception reports daily, managing process orders and due dates, and addressing risks to order fulfillment and stock levels in the monthly S&OP process

• Planning specific production lines in Frederikssund while ensuring alignment with global operations. Develop and maintain production plans while keeping a global overview.

• Owning the monthly Sales & Operations (S&OP) supply reviews for your lines, presenting data-driven insights, imbalances and trade-off scenarios

• Optimizing inventory and safety-stock levels, and support continuous improvement of planning processes

After your first year, success will mean that production lines have clear plans for order volumes and start/end dates. Decision-makers can make aligned, fact-based decisions, and risks to order fulfilment or inventory are identified, escalated and addressed in time.

**What You Bring

**We expect that you have some years of practical experience with integrated supply chain planning, ideally in process industry or a technology-service environment. You have obtained knowledge of the S&OP cycle and supply planning for finished goods and/or raw materials, probably in a production environment.

Strong proficiency in SAP ePPDS, APS solutions, Business Warehouse, Excel and PowerPoint.

As a person you have a structured, analytical approach, you pay attention to detail and have the ability to turn complex data into clear decision-making material. You succeed in your stakeholder management because of your strong communication and collaboration skills and the confidence to work across functions.

On the more formal side, you hold a relevant academic technical engineering, Supply Chain Management or Economics degree.

Fluency in written and spoken English, as well as Danish, is a prerequisite.

The role requires physic presence in Lyngby and Frederikssund.

**Why join us

**You will have a hands-on role with a broad view of the planning process—from daily operational decisions to tactical supply planning. Your analyses and recommendations will help balance production, purchasing, inventory and customer delivery needs.

Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

**JOB SUMMARY

**The position as Payroll Specialist - Mid EU will be a part of our Financial Shared Services department, which also includes Accounting and Accounts Payables. The position will be embedded and report to the Global Payroll Manager in the HQ - Copenhagen, Denmark. This role provides potential for growth within the company and the role offers an exciting opportunity for the right candidate to develop their career within Joe & The Juice. The role is a full-time position.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• The overall responsibility will be processing monthly Payroll in the following markets: Belgium, France, Switzerland, Netherlands, Monaco and Germany (Note: all mid-EU payrolls are outsourced; you will be coordinating with a provider - for now; exception made for France and the Netherlands where it is done in-house).

• Fielding employee questions regarding pay.

• Responsible to onboard new joiners into payroll systems.

• Responsible to keep HRIS/employee data up-to-date, in cooperation with local HR teams, in regard to leave and absence, personal data, etc.

• Reconciling payroll data against accounting records, preparing and reviewing payroll-related bookings and journal entries, and supporting month-end close.

• Acting as the point of coordination between local HR, Finance and external payroll providers to ensure accurate and timely payroll delivery.

• Ad-hoc HR / Payroll tasks as necessary.

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• You have high attention to detail and a strong sense of confidentiality when handling sensitive employee data.

• You have strong communication skills and can liaise confidently with employees, HR, Finance and external payroll providers.

• You can manage competing deadlines across multiple markets and payroll cycles simultaneously.

• You have a proactive, problem-solving mindset and are comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• Experience in multi-jurisdiction payroll, ideally covering 2 or more countries within the Mid Europe market (Belgium, France, Switzerland, Netherlands, Germany, Monaco).

• Fluent English required. Working proficiency in Dutch, German and/or French is a strong asset.

• Accounting experience, including reconciliation, bookings/journal entries and month-end close support.

• Solid understanding of payroll principles and local labor/tax compliance across two or more Mid Europe markets.

• Proficiency with Excel and payroll/HRIS systems; comfortable working with large datasets.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Your responsibilities will include prototype assembly and testing, preparing PCB test procedures, and maintaining PCB, design and production documentation to support product release and continuous improvement. In collaboration with PCB suppliers and product specialists, you will also contribute to design changes, ECO/ECM processes and component end-of-life (EOL) management.

**About The Role And Key Responsibilities

**Your primary responsibilities:

• Ensure the effective transfer of products from development to production, including NPI, documentation and release to production

• Contribute to the manufacture, assembly and testing of prototypes in close collaboration with development, production and suppliers

• Plan and coordinate testing, validation and verification activities, and prepare and maintain test procedures for printed circuit boards, products and subsystems

• Maintain PCB documentation, design documentation, bills of materials, product data and production processes in connection with development, handover and production maturation

• Support production with technical assistance, troubleshooting, root cause analyses and continuous improvements

• Hold an engineering degree or an equivalent technical qualification

• Have experience in product development, production engineering, Product Engineering or NPI processes

• Have hands-on experience with prototypes, testing, validation and technical troubleshooting

• Have experience with electronics. Experience with printed circuit boards, mechanics or mechatronics is considered an advantage

• Thrive at the intersection of hardware, software, production and supplier collaboration, working closely with developers, production teams, product specialists, service functions and external suppliers

• Work systematically with documentation, quality, test procedures and process improvements

• Communicate effectively in both Danish and English.

**Additional Information

**We offer:

• A central role in a strong professional environment with a high level of responsibility

• Flexibility, development opportunities, and access to highly specialized expertise

• A workplace focused on quality, innovation, and future-proof solutions

• An informal and collaborative culture that values initiative and professional curiosity

Imagine working on Denmark's most critical systems, turning unique customer data into real value through applied machine learning. As our new Data Scientist, you will play a key role in analysing customer data and training models within our established product. Ready to make an impact?

The job

You will be responsible for generating value from customer data within our established product, which underpins national security and critical infrastructure domains. Our customers are classified and cannot be disclosed, so your work will take place in secure environments, often in collaboration with Product teams, security teams and onsite at customer locations. As this is a newly established position, you will have the opportunity to help shape this role as it grows.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Analysing and preparing customer data for use in our established product

• Training, evaluating and refining machine learning models on customer data

**About The Department

**

We value collaboration, practical problem solving and the willingness to take responsibility. While you will lead your own workstream, you will also be part of a team that supports one another and responds flexibly as project priorities evolve.

Joining us means contributing to a technically challenging Greenfield project where your experience, judgement and decisions will make a visible difference.

**About You

**Why Novo

**At Novo, we don't wait for change. We drive it. Our commitment to defeating serious chronic diseases is built on more than a century of innovation, collaboration and a determination to make a meaningful difference to people's lives.

Joining our Future QC expansion programme offers the opportunity to contribute to a major investment in our manufacturing and quality control capabilities, while developing your experience within a global organisation undertaking complex engineering and expansion projects.

**Working at Novo

**Every day, we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with an unconventional spirit, a determination to innovate and a commitment to creating lasting change.

Working at Novo means joining a global healthcare company where talented people collaborate across disciplines, challenge established thinking and pursue solutions that can improve the lives of millions.

When you join us, you're not just starting a job you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

**Salary And Benefits

**Incentives And Benefits

**Novo offers a competitive compensation package, including pension, bonus opportunities and a range of employee benefits designed to support your professional and personal wellbeing.

**What We Offer

**There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce.

We offer an environment where you can develop professionally, take on meaningful challenges and build your career within a global organisation committed to innovation and long term progress.

Our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind, supporting your professional development, wellbeing and work-life balance.

At Novo, we're not chasing quick fixes we're creating lasting change for long term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives.

This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to explore new possibilities, challenge conventions and push the boundaries of what is possible.

Together, we're life changing.

SENIOR MECHANICAL PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER

Join our product development team

Mechanical Product Development • Robust Design • Plastics • From Design To Production-ready Product

Location: Allerød, north of Copenhagen • Function: R&D / Product Development

Do you enjoy the engineering disciplines that turn a good mechanical design into a robust product design that works reliably in the real world?

Qufora is a growing, design-focused medical device company. We develop intuitive products that help people with chronic bowel disorders live a more fulfilled life.

We have a relatively small and flat organisation, which means short distances from idea to decision and from decision to action. You will be close to the products, the technical decisions and the people who make them—with the opportunity to influence both the engineering solutions and how we work.

The engineering role

This is a role for someone who enjoys the fundamentals of good mechanical engineering and knows how to combine them into robust design solutions. Understanding variation and sensitivity to design products that perform consistently despite real-world variation in components, materials, processes and use.

• Interface & mechanical design – create well-defined interfaces and mechanically sound solutions without unnecessary constraints or complexity.

• Tolerances & GPS/GD&T – translate functional needs into meaningful dimensions and tolerances, using tolerance stack-ups and statistical tolerancing where relevant.

• Mechanics & structural integrity – apply solid mechanics, engineering calculations and FEA where appropriate to understand loads, deformation, strength, fatigue and failure modes.

• Materials & plastics – select materials based on function, environment, manufacturing process and long-term product performance.

• DFM/DFA & injection moulding – develop designs that can be manufactured and assembled consistently and at the required quality, working closely with toolmakers, suppliers and Operations.

• Variation & statistical analysis – use data and statistical methods to understand variation, identify critical parameters and build robustness into the design.

You will not be placed in a narrow technical box. Depending on the challenge, you may move from CAD and tolerance analysis to material selection, supplier discussions, FEA, design reviews, verification results or solving a difficult mechanical problem in an existing product.

What you will do

You will take senior technical ownership of mechanical development activities, particularly in the later stages of product development.

You will:

• Develop and mature mechanical solutions from established concepts through detailed design, verification, design transfer and launch.

• Create high-quality 3D designs and clear, production-ready 2D drawings.

• Drive difficult mechanical issues to root cause and closure.

• Work hands-on with plastics, injection-moulded components, interfaces, tolerances, materials and robust design.

• Work closely with Operations, external manufacturers, suppliers and toolmakers to turn designs into stable, manufacturable products.

• Lead and coordinate mechanical engineering activities when several people or disciplines need to contribute.

• Help strengthen our mechanical engineering methods, standards and ways of working.

What we are looking for

You have a BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development or a similar discipline and at least 8 years of experience in mechanical product development.

Ideally, you bring several of the following:

• Strong mechanical design fundamentals and engineering judgement.

• Experience with plastic product design and injection moulding.

• Advanced 3D CAD and 2D drawing skills, preferably SolidWorks.

• Strong knowledge of ISO GPS/GD&T, tolerance analysis and robust design.

• Experience with DFM/DFA, materials, mechanics and preferably FEA.

• Experience taking products from detailed development through verification and into production.

• The ability to structure complex technical work and drive issues to completion.

Experience from medical devices or another regulated industry is an advantage, but first and foremost, we are looking for a strong mechanical product developer.

Why Qufora?

At Qufora, you will work broadly across mechanical engineering disciplines and follow products through the development process rather than being limited to one narrow area. You will be close to the products, colleagues and decisions, with the opportunity to influence both engineering solutions and how we work. And because we develop medical devices, your engineering decisions ultimately matter to people who rely on our products every day.

Application

Please apply through LinkedIn. Applications will be reviewed, and interviews held on an ongoing basis.

The successful candidate will establish strong Group category governance while enabling local ownership, build strategic supplier partnerships, increase data and digital maturity, strengthen resilience and sustainability, and continuously identify opportunities to improve the total cost, service and efficiency of Royal Unibrew's logistics network.

At Royal Unibrew, you'll find the industry's most dedicated, energetic, and experienced colleagues. Together, we build the best framework for a job that precisely matches your everyday life and career aspirations.

jobs.occupation: New Product Planning & Forecasting Associate Director
jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**As New Product Planning & Forecasting Associate Director, you will bring a strong commercial perspective and shape the long-term forecasts that guide brand, portfolio and corporate decisions within Blood & Endocrine (formerly Rare Disease). Your recommendations will help senior leaders decide where to invest, so promising science reaches more patients living with rare, serious chronic diseases. Your work starts influencing real decisions from day one.

**What You’ll Bring

**We are looking for someone who combines scientific understanding and commercial insight with rigorous analysis and can turn complexity into clear recommendations. You bring:

• A Master’s or PhD in business, economics, medicine, biology or pharmacy.

• 8–10 years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry or similar experience from a top management consultancy.

• Experience developing global and local forecasts integrating epidemiological, market, clinical, and competitive assumptions.

• Experience working across the pharma value chain (e.g., clinical development, market access, commercial) to assess an early-stage assets’ clinical and commercial value.

• Strong commercial understanding and a solid grounding in natural science.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to build clear frameworks from limited data.

• Strong understanding of financial valuation methodologies and value drivers for pharmaceutical assets.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Direct experience in forecasting, new product planning, and asset valuations.

• Experience working with Rare Disease, especially in endocrine, musculoskeletal, and/or renal diseases.

**What You’ll Do

**You will play a leading role across two connected areas: New Product Planning and Forecasting. Working across assigned assets and therapy areas, you will turn complex clinical, market and competitive insights into clear recommendations that guide development and investment decisions.

**You Will

**

• Own New Product Planning & Forecasting wholistically for one or two therapeutic areas within the Blood & Endocrine

• Drive Target Product Profile development for early-stage assets working in close collaboration with the Global Project Teams.

• Lead project valuations and risk assessments for pipeline assets at critical gate passages

• Own the long-term forecast process and outcome, challenging local market assumptions and deliver realistic and ambitious forecasts.

• Develop scenarios that reveal the key value drivers, opportunities and risks, and translate them into clear actions for brands and senior management.

• Provide robust, fact-based decision support to Global Project Teams and senior leaders, ensuring alignment between commercial, clinical and regulatory strategies.

**Who You’ll Work With

**In Product & Portfolio Strategy, colleagues connect commercial strategy, medical affairs and business development across therapy areas, helping guide the Novo portfolio and strengthen competitiveness. You will join the New Product Planning & Forecasting team within Commercial Excellence & Strategic Planning in Blood & Endocrine, reporting to the Director of NPP & Forecasting.

Your work is global in reach. You will partner closely with multiple teams across the organization, both at local and regional level – as well as with external vendors and consultants. Bringing these perspectives together, you will create clarity, secure buy-in and help decisions move at pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work in a high-trust environment with a high level of independence and empowerment to make decisions on your daily work. The role offers cross value chain exposure across commercial, medical, research and supply, and the chance to influence choices that shape the future of the portfolio. You will be trusted to raise the bar, mentor others and grow your commercial and analytical expertise.

**_Salary

_**For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000.00 to 1,245,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Incentives And Benefits

**The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn analysis into decisions that shape a portfolio and progress for people living with rare, serious chronic diseases, apply for the New Product Planning & Forecasting Associate Director role by November 6th, 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
